esp8285-1m.name: Generic ESP8285 1MB module (Athom / Sonoff Basic R3 / Tuya plug)

rails.name: 5V
rails.note: the 5V header pin is an input as shipped: a diode sits between it and USB power, so a part wired to it gets nothing from USB-C alone. Bridge the IN-OUT solder pads on the back to put USB 5V on the pin, and then never feed external 5V into it while USB is connected.
